rows.label: qst660108_msg0001
rows.name: Thanks for talking to me, mo.

rows.label: qst660108_msg0002
rows.name: I'm the Great Sage's Servant, mo.

rows.label: qst660108_msg0003
rows.name:
I handle Nopon Great Sage-sama's
luggage, mo.

rows.label: qst660108_msg0004
rows.name: I have a good deal for you, mo.

rows.label: qst660108_msg0005
rows.name: I can't say it too loudly, but...

rows.label: qst660108_msg0007
rows.name:
That dull, cloudy, filthy gleam...
Just like Nopon Great Sage-sama, mo.

rows.label: qst660108_msg0009
rows.name:
If you bring me Nopon Crystals,
I'll secretly trade them for
Nopon Great Sage-sama's treasures, mo.

rows.label: qst660108_msg0010
rows.name:
Nopon Great Sage-sama has countless
treasures, so a few missing won't
be noticed, mo.

rows.label: qst660108_msg0011
rows.name:
If you get any Nopon Crystals,
please come see me, mo.
